why: Every control needs one home and one slot: presentation (pill, row, inline) derives from the home, never a prop, so a page author cannot pick the wrong one.
what: packages/basalt-ui/src/controls/{control-home,filter-slot}*. Created here. Split from v3-ctl-4-control-view, which owns ControlView, spec and the renderers.
must_not_touch: CHANGELOG.md, MIGRATING.md, llms.txt, scripts/check-budgets/** except areas/surface.ts, other areas' migrations files
contract: Frozen: ARCHITECTURE.md, this domain's contract.ts, src/core/ports.ts. Need a change: factory signal, take the reversible default. Read concepts/controls-url-state.md sections 3, 5, 9, 10 and evidence/gap-global-local-control-scope.md section 3 (prototype API). src/core/ports.ts owns ControlHandle and ControlsSlot. Primitives come only as basalt-ui/ui/<name>; date-picker by dynamic import. Strings: useMessages, English defaults in your owned src/core/messages/home.ts (qa-i2 seeds it).
exemplar: src/cards/stat-card*, src/ui/{card,badge}*, src/core/phase* (v3-exemplar-statcard; read in the tree).
change: ControlHome home to presentation (pill, row, inline derived from home, never a prop); filterSlot(specs) and filterSlot.custom(handle,label,render) as the counted escape; ToolbarGroup (ui/toolbar) for view-mode and tool homes. data-slots filter-pill, filter-row. Keys controls.filters, resetAll. 2.x donors stay beside the new files. Rule: control-home (rung 5, body in ctl-8). Skill: generated docs/control-home.md. Tests: layout per home, axe, type guards. A new public value symbol also lands, in this Issue, its raise in scripts/check-budgets/areas/surface.ts (the ceiling +1 and a `raises` row with from, to, consumer and repo) and its name in scripts/consumers.json (`<symbol>: <repo>:<path>`); make check refuses the symbol without them. The shard is scripts/export-surface/controls.json, written by `export-surface.mjs --update`.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: Layout and axe tests under tests/layout/ on a fixture host (tests/layout/fixture/) at 1440, 768, 390, 320; screenshots of the fixture host taken by the layout test (1800x1200 and 390x844, dark and light, at most 3 rounds) and named in the PR body. Homes pill, row and inline each with a bound and an overriding widget.
acceptance: layout at 1440, 768, 390 and 320: no horizontal overflow with 8 filters and with 0 filters; hit floor 44 coarse
the override cue renders in pill, row and inline homes and shows text, not colour alone (computed text assertion)
a folded pill renders the row form, never a nested pill (nested portal is not an outside click)
filterSlot.custom is counted: a fixture using it appears in the escapes count (test)
axe zero serious or critical with a pill popover open
git diff --name-only lists only owned paths
out_of_scope: ControlView, spec, renderers (ctl-4), FilterSet fold and Filters (n) sheet (ctl-5), ViewTabs and globals (ctl-6), lint bodies (ctl-8).
